Moments 1

    A happy tummy

    Food slowly drops over time. A full kitten will politely decline another serving.

    Fresh water

    Mochi wanders over to her fountain by herself. Tap the fountain to invite a drink.

    Play and pounce

    Steer the toy, then hold it still near your kitten and watch for the wiggle.

    Strokes and slow blinks

    Stroke her in the room. Close friends answer with a slow blink, cat for “I love you”.

    A soft brush

    Brushing keeps her fluff fluffy. She lets you know when it’s time.

    Sweet dreams

    Rest restores energy, even while you’re away. Care is saved in this browser.
